description: This file defines serialization utilities, including functions for converting between strings and various data types, handling Unicode and ASCII conversions, and a template parser class for serialization tasks. It also includes external references to other modules and supports different character encodings.

classes.name: ParserType
classes.description: A template class for parsing serialized data streams, managing states such as loaded, quoted, and line endings, and invoking parent handlers during serialization.

methods.name: ToCharacter
methods.description: Converts a character from char or wchar_t to TCHAR, handling Unicode and platform-specific conversions.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Converts various data types and strings to their string representations, considering Unicode support.

methods.name: FromString
methods.description: Parses strings to populate data types like integers, booleans, and binary data, supporting different formats like hex and Base64.

methods.name: ToHexString
methods.description: Converts a byte array to a hexadecimal string.

methods.name: FromHexString
methods.description: Converts a hexadecimal string back to a byte array.

methods.name: ToString (Base64)
methods.description: Encodes a byte array into a Base64 string with optional padding.

methods.name: FromString (Base64)
methods.description: Decodes a Base64 string into a byte array.

methods.name: CodePointToUTF16
methods.description: Converts a Unicode code point to UTF-16 low and high parts.

methods.name: UTF16ToCodePoint
methods.description: Converts UTF-16 low and high parts back to a Unicode code point.

methods.name: ToCodePoint
methods.description: Extracts a Unicode code point from a UTF-8 or UTF-16 encoded string.

methods.name: FromCodePoint
methods.description: Encodes a Unicode code point into a UTF-8 or UTF-16 string.

methods.name: ToQuotedString
methods.description: Creates a quoted string with a specified quote character.
